races.name: South West Rail Solutions Ltd. "National Hunt" Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Hardly Surprising
runners_data.note: Hold-up style suits the likely strong pace perfectly, improving form on soft ground with 71 days freshness beneficial
runners_data.comment: Sets standard on his third at Doncaster and he's open to more progress back in trip
runners_data.spotlight: Owned by JP McManus when winning his Irish point; badly hampered on his hurdling debut but he's found improvement with two placed efforts (2m3f, soft) since; has leading claims on his latest third at Doncaster and he has shaped as though this slight drop back in trip could suit; key player.

runners_data.name: Limier d'Arthel
runners_data.note: Prominent style allows tactical flexibility, claiming jockey takes useful weight off Paul Hobbs runner
runners_data.comment: French bumper winner who was a close second over hurdles at Exeter last month; respected
runners_data.spotlight: French bumper winner in April 2024; didn't get very far (fell at first) on hurdling/stable debut in January but he travelled well for a long way when a close second at Exeter (2m, good to soft; hood added) last month; wandered around in closing stages but that was a creditable effort in a big field and he should improve for the experience; respected.

runners_data.name: Handmedownastar
runners_data.note: Prominent racer from in-form Seamus Mullins yard, faded last time suggests stamina doubts over this longer trip
runners_data.comment: Point winner but was well-held third on hurdling debut at Fontwell; needs improvement
runners_data.spotlight: Easily justified favouritism in an Irish maiden point late last year; well backed into 5-1 on hurdling debut at Fontwell (2m1f, soft) last month but he faded into a well-held third; should benefit from that run but this looks a tougher and he needs improvement.

runners_data.name: Dutch Corner
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with consistent placed form, Dan Skelton's 8/39 strike-rate requires scrutiny despite horse's ability
runners_data.comment: Placed behind Sober Glory at Newbury and was runner-up at Exeter last time; respected
runners_data.spotlight: Third against useful rivals on first two hurdling starts and he ran another promising race when second of 14 at Exeter (2m, good to soft) last month; looked a bit tricky last time but that form puts him firmly in the picture and he would have finished closer but for a bad mistake two out.

runners_data.name: Docteur Romeo
runners_data.note: Prominent style but fading tendency is major concern, pulled up last time suggests fundamental issues
runners_data.comment: Well held in sole bumper and was pulled up on his hurdling debut last month
runners_data.spotlight: Well held in sole bumper in Decemeber 2024 and he returned after a long absence with a pulled-up effort on hurdling debut at Exeter (2m, good to soft) last month.

runners_data.name: JPR Two
runners_data.note: Prominent racer but fading pattern and 120-day absence raise serious fitness doubts for Paul Nicholls
runners_data.comment: Well-related 5yo but he was well held in sole bumper; now goes hurdling after a break
runners_data.spotlight: 120,000euros 3yo; half-brother to three winners, notably his owner's JPR One (smart 2m-2m3f hurdle/chase); 9-2 for an Exeter bumper (2m, soft) in December but he weakened into a remote eighth of 15; now goes hurdling after a break and he needs to leave that initial form a long way behind.

runners_data.name: Dante's Rocco
runners_data.note: Hold-up style suits race shape, showed improvement last time but 5lb claimer lacks experience for this level
runners_data.comment: Good third when dropped to 1m7f at Wincanton and he's open to more progress; shortlisted
runners_data.spotlight: Placed on Irish point debut in December; remote fourth of six on hurdling debut at Newbury (2m4f, soft) in February but he found lots of improvement on the drop to 1m7f when third at Wincanton (good) 12 days ago; needs to build on that but he has a good pedigree and is open to more progress.

runners_data.name: Saffron Belle
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner but distant in two bumpers, trainer's 0/5 record and 7lb claimer suggest limited ability
runners_data.comment: Struggled in two bumpers this year and can only be watched on hurdling debut
runners_data.spotlight: Big prices and she's been beaten a long way in two bumpers this year; can only be watched on hurdling debut.

runners_data.name: Warfleet
runners_data.note: Lead runner after 394-day break creates huge fitness concerns, pulled up last hurdle start raises serious doubts
runners_data.comment: Pulled up on hurdling debut last spring and he now returns for another new yard; opposable
runners_data.spotlight: Runner-up in a Market Rasen bumper in July 2024 but he's had only two runs since and was pulled up on his hurdling debut last spring; has plenty to prove after 13 months off and he's already with his third different trainer; hood added.

runners_data.name: Poet's Muse
runners_data.note: Lead runner but beaten 46+ lengths in recent hurdle starts, lowest official rating reflects limited ability
runners_data.comment: Her point win is nothing to shout about and she's been tailed off in both hurdle runs
runners_data.spotlight: Her point win is nothing to shout about and she's been beaten 56l and 46l in two hurdle runs (2m5f/2m3f) this year; no appeal.

runners_data.name: Ask A Sainte
runners_data.note: Hold-up style fits race shape well, showed improvement when fourth last time after poor hurdling debut
runners_data.comment: Promising fourth when front-running in big field at Wincanton in December; in the mix
runners_data.spotlight: Close third at Wincanton (1m7f, good) in the first of his two bumper runs last spring; tailed off on hurdling debut in November but he left that form well behind when a front-running fourth at Wincanton (1m7f, soft) the following month; was beaten around 15l but that was a promising effort in a big field and he's a player if he can find more improvement.

runners_data.name: Mrs Pen
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner but massive prices and tailed-off recent efforts suggest she lacks competitive ability entirely
runners_data.comment: Massive prices and she's finished tailed off in two hurdle runs at Exeter (2m) this spring
runners_data.spotlight: Massive prices and she's finished tailed off in two hurdle runs at Exeter (2m, good to soft) this spring.

races.paceDynamic: Warfleet and Poet's Muse will ensure this maiden hurdle starts at a solid clip, with both confirmed front runners likely to dispute the early lead. The honest gallop should continue through the middle stages given the combination of two keen pace-setters over this intermediate trip on testing ground. The soft going at Newton Abbot will magnify stamina demands in the final half-mile, putting pressure on those who race keenly or lack fitness. This race shape heavily favours hold-up horses with proven stamina reserves who can stay on strongly when the pace-setters weaken.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Gallop Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Warfleet and Poet's Muse engage in a genuine speed duel through the early stages
scenarios.body: The honest pace on soft ground will expose fitness doubts and stamina limitations, setting up the race perfectly for closers with proven staying power. Hold-up horses like Hardly Surprising and Dutch Corner can pick off tiring leaders in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Tactical Affair Benefits
scenarios.trigger: If one of the leaders gets an uncontested lead after the other fades early
scenarios.body: The reduced pace allows prominent racers and those with tactical speed to stay closer throughout before producing their challenge. This scenario suits horses who can travel well in behind before quickening when asked.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Warfleet finds significant improvement after his long break and gets first run on rivals
scenarios.body: The leader's class tells under pressure as he holds on grimly from those who leave their challenge too late. Early position proves crucial on the testing ground with stamina at a premium.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If both main pace angles disappoint and the gallop becomes crawling throughout
scenarios.body: The lack of genuine pace turns this into a sprint finish where tactical positioning and a turn of foot matter more than stamina. This rare scenario could favor any horse getting the right split at the right time.

watchPoints.text: Warfleet could set inappropriate fractions given his 394-day layoff and tendency to pull hard when fresh
Dutch Corner and Hardly Surprising both hold-up horses may get in each other's way if tracking same position
Limier d'Arthel's jumping after falling at the first hurdle on stable debut remains a significant unknown
The combination of soft ground and 2m2½f trip could expose several runners with stamina limitations late on
Several claiming jockeys including Pritchard and Sansom could impact tactical positioning in a competitive maiden

races.name: Les Drew Hello Matey I'm 80 Handicap Chase

runners_data.name: Ideallko
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning from 59-day break under in-form jockey Conor Ring but needs to recapture old enthusiasm.
runners_data.comment: On a fair mark back from a short break but needs a revival after a few poor efforts
runners_data.spotlight: Did his winning for Evan Williams in batches, latterly when notching a hat-trick the winter before last; on a fair mark back from a short break but needs a revival after a few poor efforts in recent times.

runners_data.name: Begin The Luck
runners_data.note: Proven front-runner with excellent course record who thrives on soft ground and gets stronger in testing conditions.
runners_data.comment: Won the corresponding race in 2023 and finished second in it 12 months ago; shortlisted
runners_data.spotlight: Won the corresponding race in 2023 and finished second in it 12 months ago (heavy); always tended to do well this time of the year and the more rain the better for him; goes on the shortlist.

runners_data.name: Jack's A Legend
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer returning from 311-day layoff wearing first-time tongue-tie with inexperienced 7lb claimer aboard.
runners_data.comment: Better off into ordinary handicap company for his new yard; may need this at his age
runners_data.spotlight: 2m4f point winner who's done most racing under rules over shorter; tough task in a C&D hunter chase when last seen ten months ago and, while better off into ordinary handicap company for his new yard, it's possible he'll need this at his age.

runners_data.name: Jack Doyen
runners_data.note: Late-finishing specialist in career-best form with recent 10-day turnaround, typically peaks in March conditions.
runners_data.comment: Wins have all come in late March; remains fairly treated now back in form; considered
runners_data.spotlight: Wins have all come in late March, latterly off 5lb lower at Hereford ten days ago, so it's fair to say this is his time of year; adaptable as regards ground and remains fairly treated now back in form.

runners_data.name: Firefly Lane
runners_data.note: Prominent runner badly out of handicap carrying just 142lbs but has regressed significantly in recent outings.
runners_data.comment: Beaten long way from 10lb out of the handicap latest; similarly tough task from 9lb wrong
runners_data.spotlight: Course regular who's regressed in recent times; beaten a long way from 10lb out of the handicap last time and has a similarly tough task from 9lb wrong today.

runners_data.name: Palawan Du Mazet
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with excellent soft ground record, twice successful on heavy/soft surfaces this season.
runners_data.comment: Finished first in three of his four chases; could be capable of better
runners_data.spotlight: Below form on good ground in December but finished first in his other three chases (all on soft/heavy; disqualified on first occasion); only raised another 3lb for 2m4f Leicester success in February and could yet be capable of better.

runners_data.name: Devilsrollthedice
runners_data.note: Prominent runner making handicap chase debut in first-time cheekpieces after disappointing hurdles performances.
runners_data.comment: Come in for support last twice; pulled up each time but evidently felt capable of better
runners_data.spotlight: Well backed ahead of his handicap debut over hurdles in January but never looked happy; again came in for support over fences four weeks ago, in first-time cheekpieces, but was again pulled up; evidently felt capable of better.

runners_data.name: Tractor Jack
runners_data.note: Prominent runner prone to fading in finish making chasing debut for in-form Joe Tizzard stable.
runners_data.comment: Only seen sporadically over hurdles; needs a deal more on today's chasing debut
runners_data.spotlight: Only seen sporadically over hurdles the past two years, latterly when not looking to see out 3m a month ago; needs a deal of improvement on today's chasing debut.

races.paceDynamic: Begin The Luck will set a steady pace from the front with limited early pressure in this 8-runner handicap chase. Firefly Lane, Devilsrollthedice and Tractor Jack may sit prominent early but none are confirmed pace forcers. The gallop will build gradually through the middle stages as Begin The Luck maintains control. This sustainable tempo strongly favours hold-up horses like Ideallko, Jack's A Legend, Jack Doyen and Palawan Du Mazet who can time their challenges late.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Begin The Luck sets an even gallop without serious early pace pressure
scenarios.body: The race becomes a tactical affair with plenty left for the finish, allowing the closers to unleash their strongest asset - a finishing kick. Quality hold-up performers with fresh legs will sweep past the leaders in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Begin The Luck gets an uncontested lead and kicks clear approaching the last fence
scenarios.body: The 10-year-old's proven course form and love of testing ground allows him to maintain his advantage to the line. His 2023 course victory proves he can execute this tactical scenario successfully.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent runners applies early pressure to Begin The Luck and softens him up
scenarios.body: The pace becomes more genuine throughout, suiting a horse that can sit handy and has the class to respond when the race develops. This tactical battle removes the pure front-runner advantage.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Surprise Package
scenarios.trigger: If the classier horses fail to handle the testing conditions or make jumping errors
scenarios.body: A lightly-weighted runner benefits from the handicap system and gets first run on the fancied horses. The soft ground levels the playing field for lesser lights.

watchPoints.text: Begin The Luck must be given early respect as his front-running style perfectly suits the likely tactical scenario
Jack's A Legend carries significant layoff risk returning after 311 days with an inexperienced conditional jockey
Tractor Jack's stamina limitations could be exposed if the pace becomes searching in the closing stages
Ideallko needs to show early enthusiasm from his hold-up position after a disappointing recent campaign
Palawan Du Mazet's jumping must be monitored as he attempts to replicate his recent soft ground success

races.name: South West Rail Solutions Ltd. Mares' Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Northern Air
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer returning after 94 days off but has strong soft ground record with 9 from 9 starts and won point-to-point on similar conditions.
runners_data.comment: Disappointing in three chase runs for Dan Skelton and he needs major revival for new yard
runners_data.spotlight: Soft-ground point winner who won a maiden hurdle (2m, good to soft) for Fergal O'Brien last January; disappointing in three chase runs for Dan Skelton this winter but she still has low mileage and is on a dangerous mark back over hurdles; needs checking in market for new yard.

runners_data.name: Green Sky
runners_data.note: Natural front runner with David Pipe's 0/12 recent record a concern, but her flat speed gives tactical options if she gets easy early lead.
runners_data.comment: 0-12 over hurdles but she's well treated on best form in this sphere; needs a close look
runners_data.spotlight: Flat winner who was a creditable fourth on Polytrack (1m5f) on her penultimate run in February; 0-12 over hurdles but she's not had many chances in handicaps and is well treated on her best form in this sphere; needs a close look back over hurdles.

runners_data.name: Jackeline
runners_data.note: Hold-up type who pulled up in last two chase starts and needs to prove she handles return to hurdles after disappointing winter.
runners_data.comment: Pulled up in last two chases but reverts to hurdling on a dangerous mark
runners_data.spotlight: Close third over hurdles at Chepstow (2m, good) in October but she's not taken to fences this winter and has been pulled up in last two starts; bit to prove but she's on a dangerous mark back in this sphere and could be a big factor if she can revive; blinkers worn in last two starts are removed.

runners_data.name: Parikarma
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse well-suited to course and distance having won here before, with consistent soft ground form making her serious contender.
runners_data.comment: C&D winner and she's a player if she can bounce back from a disappointing run at Taunton
runners_data.spotlight: Six-time winner with three on the Flat and three over hurdles; didn't fire at Taunton last month but her last win was over C&D (good) and she's well handicapped if she can bounce back near her best; has possibilities in change of headgear.

runners_data.name: Reel Orange
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer who was runner-up on stable debut last month and should improve for Joe Tizzard despite Hereford disappointment.
runners_data.comment: 11-race maiden but has claims on her second at Exeter two runs back; cheekpieces added
runners_data.spotlight: 11-race maiden who was disappointing at Hereford ten days ago, but she finished runner-up in Exeter handicap (2m2f, good to soft) on her stable debut last month; that form puts her in the picture and first-time cheekpieces could give her a lift.

runners_data.name: Getarose
runners_data.note: Hold-up maiden carrying bottom weight but has never finished closer than 13 lengths and looks outclassed at this level.
runners_data.comment: Seven-race maiden who has not finished closer than 13l to a winner; down the list
runners_data.spotlight: Seven-race maiden who has not finished closer than 13l to a winner and was laboured in a Hereford handicap (2m3f, good) last month; dropped another 3lb but she needs a transformation back in trip.

runners_data.name: Eskimo Sam
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning to action after stable switch, but warning flag for fading in finish suggests stamina doubts over this trip.
runners_data.comment: Unexposed 7yo but she needs improvement on this drop back in trip; hood reapplied
runners_data.spotlight: Down the field in four runs for Tom Lacey and she returned after long absence with well-held fifth on handicap/stable debut at Exeter (2m2f, good to soft) last month; still early days but she needs improvement on this drop back in trip; hood reapplied.

races.paceDynamic: Green Sky appears the only natural front runner in this field of hold-up performers, meaning she can dictate terms without pressure early on. The sustained gallop over 2m1f on soft ground will test stamina reserves, with most runners looking to come from off the pace in the final half-mile. Northern Air and Parikarma have proven soft ground form and should be positioned to strike late. This pace scenario strongly favours hold-up horses with proven stamina who can finish powerfully when others tire.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Late Kick Decides
scenarios.trigger: If Green Sky sets sustainable fractions and the field bunches turning for home
scenarios.body: The patient hold-up horses get their ideal setup as Green Sky's early work pays dividends for closers. Northern Air and Parikarma can time their runs perfectly when the pace lifts in the final quarter-mile.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Green Sky gets soft early sectionals and has enough left to resist late challenges
scenarios.body: Her 68 TopSpeed gives her tactical speed to kick clear when the pace quickens, holding off pursuers who leave their runs too late. The patient approach backfires as she controls the race from pillar to post.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Stamina Test Develops
scenarios.trigger: If the soft ground and sustained gallop finds out horses with fitness or stamina doubts
scenarios.body: Northern Air's 94-day break or Jackeline's recent pulled-up efforts prove costly as only the fittest survive. Parikarma's course and distance win and Reel Orange's recent run give them the edge in a grueling finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If Green Sky goes too fast early or multiple horses make premature moves
scenarios.body: The race becomes a tactical mess with horses getting in each other's way as the pace dies completely. An outsider like Eskimo Sam or Getarose benefits from the scrappy finish when class horses disappoint.

watchPoints.text: Green Sky's early fractions will determine if her front-running tactics pay off or set up the race for late closers with superior stamina reserves.
Northern Air's fitness after 94 days layoff could be crucial given his hold-up style requires a strong finish to be effective.
Jackeline's jumping and enthusiasm after being pulled up twice recently will reveal if she's ready to compete at this level again.
The soft ground conditions may expose any horses lacking peak fitness, particularly those who haven't raced recently like Parikarma (26 days).
Jockey Imogen Mathias's 7lb claim on Parikarma could prove valuable in a tight finish given the mare's solid course and distance record.

races.name: Happy 45th Birthday Andy Hurtley Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Tahmuras
runners_data.note: Prominent racer returning from 78 days off with first-time blinkers that sparked improvement at Windsor in soft conditions.
runners_data.comment: Turned things around with a second at Windsor and has claims if he can back that up
runners_data.spotlight: Pulled up on all four starts last year but he turned things around with a rallying second at Windsor (2m6f, soft; first-time blinkers) in January; 2lb higher after a break but he remains well treated on old form and this return to quicker ground should be fine; possibilities.

runners_data.name: Scarface
runners_data.note: Last year's winner off 2lb higher mark, prominent style suits the tactical setup despite inconsistent recent form.
runners_data.comment: C&D winner who bounced back with a fair third at Newbury latest; each-way claims
runners_data.spotlight: Four-time chase winner and his last success was in this race (off 2lb lower) last year; has been in and out this season but he bounced back with a fair third in Class 2 handicap at Newbury (2m4f, good to soft) two weeks ago; has possibilities if he can back that up and he's versatile ground-wise.

runners_data.name: Royal Jewel
runners_data.note: Course and distance winner in autumn, prominent racer with strong recent Taunton form on similar heavy ground.
runners_data.comment: C&D winner who scored at Taunton in February and was a good third there latest; respected
runners_data.spotlight: Won over C&D (good to soft) in the autumn and he got back on the scoresheet at Taunton (2m7f, heavy) in February; ran another good race when third at Taunton (good) last month and he should be in the mix again on this drop back in trip.

runners_data.name: Calimystic
runners_data.note: Lightly raced 7yo with perfect 2-2 chase record, prominent style ideally suited to track uncontested leader.
runners_data.comment: 2-2 over fences this winter and he's open to more progress back in trip; big player
runners_data.spotlight: Very lightly raced 7yo; record of 1-3 over hurdles and he's won at Newbury (2m6f, good) and Sandown (3m, soft) in his two chase runs this winter; up another 6lb but he travelled strongly on his penultimate run and is open to more progress on this drop back in trip; big player.

runners_data.name: Kap Ouest
runners_data.note: Only genuine hold-up horse faces tactical nightmare with lone closer role, despite recent Exeter win showing promise.
runners_data.comment: Unexposed chaser who was an easy winner at Exeter last month; respected up 9lb
runners_data.spotlight: Hurdle winner who made it second time lucky over fences with an easy win at Exeter (2m2f, good to soft) last month; this is much tougher off 9lb higher but that was a clear personal best last time and he could have a lot more to offer as a chaser.

runners_data.name: Nickelforce
runners_data.note: Prominent racer returning from 147-day break but has won fresh before, needs pace to develop properly.
runners_data.comment: Ended last year with a win but he's 7lb higher here and this is highly competitive
runners_data.spotlight: Had form figures of 23243221 last year and he was as good as ever when scoring at Wincanton (2m4f, good) in November; has won when fresh in the past but he's 7lb higher than last time and this is highly competitive on his return.

runners_data.name: Hardy Du Seuil
runners_data.note: Prominent racer with solid fence form, 5lb claiming jockey Isabelle Ryder provides useful weight relief.
runners_data.comment: Has done well on belated return to fences including a near-miss at Carlisle; shortlisted
runners_data.spotlight: Won over hurdles in November and has done well on his belated return to fences, following a near-miss at Carlisle with a creditable third at Newbury (2m, good to soft) in February; still looks feasibly treated and he was a dual chase winner (2m/2m4f) in his youth; dangerous back up in trip.

runners_data.name: Bumpy Evans
runners_data.note: Natural front-runner with 5-8 chase record returning from 167 days, will get uncontested lead but faces quality field.
runners_data.comment: Record of 5-8 over fences and he's not ruled out back in trip on his reappearance
runners_data.spotlight: Front-runner who is 5-8 over fences and he found more progress when runner-up in the Durham National (3m5f, good) in October; this is a different test on his return but he still looks on a workable mark and was successful over 2m4f last spring; has worn a hood in all of his chase runs but the headgear is missing today.

races.paceDynamic: Bumpy Evans is the sole confirmed front-runner and will dictate terms from the flag, likely getting an easy lead with no pressure from the prominent-racing pack of Tahmuras, Scarface, Royal Jewel, Calimystic, Nickelforce and Hardy Du Seuil. With only Kap Ouest sitting back as a hold-up horse, this creates a tactical scenario where the front-runner can control fractions without being harassed early. The sustainable pace followed by a sprint finish strongly favours prominent racers who can track Bumpy Evans and pounce late, rather than the lone hold-up horse who faces a positioning nightmare.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Trackers Pounce
scenarios.trigger: If Bumpy Evans sets uncontested fractions and the prominent horses get ideal tracking positions
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace pressure allows trackers to conserve energy before striking in the final half-mile. Horses like Calimystic and Royal Jewel benefit from their class and tactical positioning.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Wire-To-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Bumpy Evans gets completely uncontested fractions and the prominent pack fails to organise
scenarios.body: With no early harassment, the leader builds an unassailable advantage that the prominent horses cannot reel in despite their quality. His 5-8 chase record proves his front-running effectiveness.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly crawling and Kap Ouest gets a perfect run through
scenarios.body: The slow early gallop sets up perfectly for the lone closer to utilise superior finishing kick. His recent Exeter win shows he has the acceleration to exploit tactical scenarios.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If Bumpy Evans goes too slow early then quickens dramatically turning for home
scenarios.body: The sudden injection of pace catches several prominent horses flat-footed, creating a messy finish where fresher horses prevail. Late tactical moves determine the outcome rather than sustained galloping.

watchPoints.text: Bumpy Evans setting fractions too slow early then injecting sudden pace - will catch prominent horses unprepared for gear change
Kap Ouest's positioning through the early stages as the lone hold-up horse in a slowly-run race could be crucial
Calimystic and Royal Jewel tracking positions behind Bumpy Evans - whoever gets first run may prove decisive
The prominent pack organising too early to pressure Bumpy Evans could backfire and set race up for Kap Ouest
Ground conditions affecting jumping rhythm at the final three fences where races often change hands

races.name: South West Rail Solutions Ltd. Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Call Me Legend
runners_data.note: Prominent runner in good form but faces 3lb rise after near-miss, may find winning mark elusive over this stamina-sapping trip
runners_data.comment: Has form figures of 431122 in handicaps and that latest second was a near-miss; key player
runners_data.spotlight: Has form figures of 431122 since switched in handicaps and that latest second was a near-miss at Exeter (2m7f, good) 13 days ago; up another 3lb but he's versatile ground-wise and is open to more progress over staying trips; strongly respected with cheekpieces added.

runners_data.name: Kruger Park
runners_data.comment: Won at Fontwell (3m2f) in December but he's not easy to predict and was tailed off latest
runners_data.spotlight: Outstayed a subsequent winner when scoring at Fontwell (3m2f, good to soft) on Boxing Day but he flopped in his follow-up bid at Newbury in February; only 2lb higher than for that last success but he's not easy to predict and needs to bounce back again; stablemate of Rickety Bridge.

runners_data.name: Striking A Pose
runners_data.note: Prominent type on dangerous low mark but pulled up twice recently, question marks over current wellbeing and motivation
runners_data.comment: Five-time hurdle winner but he's struggled in three of his last four runs; passed over
runners_data.spotlight: Five-time hurdle winner who is on a dangerous mark but he was pulled up twice in December and beat only rival at Wincanton (3m, good) last month; has something to prove and yard also runs Walk Tall.

runners_data.name: Rickety Bridge
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who may have needed comeback run 42 days ago, Paul Nicholls stable in form but handicap mark looks testing
runners_data.comment: Lightly raced in recent years and has struggled in last three handicaps; cheekpieces added
runners_data.spotlight: Won a Southwell maiden (2m4f, soft) in March 2024 but he's had only six runs since and has struggled in his last three handicaps; may have needed his comeback run (2m7f) in February but he needs a major revival back up in trip; cheekpieces added.

runners_data.name: Crossgales King
runners_data.note: Won last time out staying on strongly over 3m1f, 5lb rise manageable and prominent style suits but inexperienced Callum Pritchard(3) takes over
runners_data.comment: 6yo who won at Wincanton (3m1f) last month and he's open to more progress; key player
runners_data.spotlight: Off the mark at the sixth attempt over hurdles when justifying favouritism in a Wincanton handicap (3m1f, good to soft) last month; up 5lb but he stayed on strongly for that comfortable win and is open to more progress at this new trip; key player.

runners_data.name: Top Guy
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer with excellent recent form, won at Aintree over 3m1f and hold-up style perfectly suits this race shape
runners_data.comment: Runner-up at Market Rasen (2m7f) last time and he's still unexposed as a stayer; dangerous
runners_data.spotlight: Just one win from ten starts over hurdles but that came at Aintree (3m1f) in December and he bounced back with a creditable second at Market Rasen (2m7f, good to soft) last month; nudged up 2lb but he's still unexposed as a stayer and has possibilities back up in trip.

runners_data.name: Sam's Amour
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning from 99-day break with bled-from-nose concern, fitness and wellbeing major question marks
runners_data.comment: Triple hurdle winner who has form over C&D but she needs a big turnaround after a break
runners_data.spotlight: Triple hurdle winner (2m2f-2m5f) but she struggled in her final three runs last year and was reported to have bled from the nose on chase debut in December; finished runner-up over C&D (good) last summer but she needs a big turnaround after a break.

runners_data.name: Walk Tall
runners_data.note: Hold-up type who was impressive bumper runner-up, hasn't fired in hurdles yet but this stamina test could unlock improvement
runners_data.comment: Lightly raced 6yo who was runner-up over 2m6f last time; one to keep an eye on at new trip
runners_data.spotlight: Irish point winner who looked a nice prospect when runner-up in a bumper at Exeter last February; hasn't set the world alight in five goes over hurdles this term but he kept on well when a 12l second in a Hereford handicap (2m6f, soft) in February; should have more to offer in this sphere and he needs watching in market on this step up to 3m2f.

races.paceDynamic: Call Me Legend will set a sustainable pace from the front with his prominent style, likely joined by fellow prominent runners Striking A Pose, Rickety Bridge, and Crossgales King in the early positions. The 3m2½f distance and good to soft ground will create a searching test of stamina rather than speed, with the pace likely steady early before quickening from three out. With multiple prominent types and limited early pace pressure, this sets up perfectly for the hold-up horses Top Guy and Walk Tall to deliver late challenges. This race shape strongly favours hold-up performers who can stay the extended trip and finish fastest.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Prevail
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners go too hard early trying to establish position
scenarios.body: The sustained pace over this stamina-sapping trip will find out the leaders, allowing the patient hold-up types to sweep past in the final half-mile. Top Guy and Walk Tall are perfectly positioned to exploit this tactical advantage with their proven finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Call Me Legend or Crossgales King can dictate fractions without serious pressure
scenarios.body: One of the prominent runners will get first run on their rivals and prove too strong in the straight, with their early positioning advantage proving decisive. The hold-up horses may find too much to do over this extended distance.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is unusually slow with multiple prominent runners checking each other
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where any horse with tactical speed can win, regardless of preferred running style. This chaos scenario opens the door for any runner with residual ability on their current mark.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Stamina Test Elimination
scenarios.trigger: If the ground rides softer than advertised and the pace is genuinely strong throughout
scenarios.body: Only the most genuine stayers will be in contention at the business end, with several runners failing to see out the trip. The race becomes about pure stamina rather than tactical positioning.

runners_data.name: Frenati
